name: NGC 2441, SN 1995E field (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 2441, a nearly face-on spiral galaxy and host of the supernova SN 1995E, seen by Hubble.
label: sn1995e-hubble
story: In a spiral arm of this nearly face-on galaxy, the Type Ia supernova SN 1995E once blazed. Hubble returned to test whether a faint source at the site is a light echo, the supernova's light reflected by dust near the explosion.

claims.text: NGC 2441 is a spiral galaxy seen nearly face-on
SN 1995E is a Type Ia supernova
The light echo candidate source lies in a spiral arm in the galaxy's outer regions
Hubble observed the site to test whether a source seen earlier is a light echo
A light echo here would be light scattered by dust near the supernova
